fields.label: Type d'étude
fields.value: étude comparative d'évaluation de Jev par rapport à deux LLMs
fields.quote: We evaluated Jev on two datasets from our previous study of title and abstract screening10 and compared Jev with two generative LLMs using the same prompts.

fields.label: Données
fields.value: 1381 records de la revue systématique de la thérapie lumineuse pour le trouble bipolaire et 3146 de la revue systématique de la pharmacothérapie adjuvante pour la dépression bipolaire
fields.quote: We analyzed two datasets previously used to evaluate GPT-3.5 and GPT-410: 1381 records from a systematic review of bright light therapy for bipolar disorder (hereafter, light therapy)24 and 3146 from a systematic review of adjunctive pharmacotherapy for bipolar depression.25 Eligibility criteria

fields.label: Modèles
fields.quote: Jev achieved high screening sensitivity at the prespecified cutoff, retained all reports included after full-text assessment, and cost less than the tested LLM configurations.

fields.label: Résultats
fields.quote: highest cutoff retaining all human-retained light-therapy records in every run was 22%, with specificity of 99.2% and a reduction in review volume of 97.3%.

fields.label: Limites
fields.value: Limitation de généralisation à d’autres domaines cliniques, données limitées.
fields.quote: Several limitations affect the interpretation of these findings. First, both reviews concerned bipolar disorder, limiting generalizability to other clinical areas. The datasets also contained few.
